$comment: Sprint planning configuration. This is the ONLY file a new user needs to edit. Replace every value with your own before the first run.

owner.$comment: Used as the AssignedTo filter in every board query and as the 'From' line on the one-pager.
owner.name: Your Name

velocity.$comment: trailing-3-sprint is strongly preferred. single-prior-sprint is noisy — one large bundle closing late distorts it.

output.$comment: Where the one-pager markdown and HTML are written. Supports ~ expansion.

onePager.$comment: Default recipient shown in the masthead. Override per-run if sharing more widely.

requestInformation.$comment: Custom fields some orgs require on every work item create and update. Set to null if your org has none. Adjust ProposalType per item — Update for existing content, New for net-new.

conventions.$comment: Point values the planner should treat as house style. Set to null to have the skill ask instead of assuming.
